mission.intro: As the sole female developer in the GIZ and GEA "Digitalize for Jobs" program, I trained more than 100 women entrepreneurs across Ghana in the digital skills their businesses needed.
points: Trained more than 100 women entrepreneurs across Ghana in the digital skills their businesses needed
Taught websites, social media and digital literacy through hands-on training sessions
mission.conclusion: That experience shaped how I work. Technology only matters if the person using it can run their business with it, so I build for the person on the other side of the screen.

differentiators.title: I Start With The Customer
differentiators.description: I started in customer success, and I still plan every message from the customer's side of the screen before I open a tool.

differentiators.title: Every Stage Is Its Own Problem
differentiators.description: Sign-up, payment, onboarding, the day itself, the days after, win-back. Each one has its own timing and its own message.

differentiators.title: Messages That Wait For A Real Moment
differentiators.description: Every sequence checks before it sends, so someone who has already paid or booked never gets the email that no longer applies.

differentiators.title: I Build The Product Fix Myself
differentiators.description: I am also a frontend developer, so when the fix belongs in the product and not the inbox, I can ship it.
